layers.name: Sky Gradient
layers.description: The foundation layer of the evening sky, fading from twilight blue to sunset orange.
layers.paintingTip: Perform a wet-on-wet wash using a 2-inch flat brush. Start with Cobalt Blue at the top, blending into a mixture of Naples Yellow and Cadmium Orange towards the horizon.

elements.content: <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5d7fa3" /><stop offset="60%" stop-color="#fbd185" /><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f5b154" /></linearGradient>

layers.name: Soft Evening Clouds
layers.description: Wispy, low-hanging clouds catching the last light.
layers.paintingTip: Use a soft mop brush with a diluted mix of Payne's Gray and Alizarin Crimson. Dab gently while the sky is still slightly damp to achieve soft edges.

layers.name: Power Station Structures
layers.description: The blocky, industrial forms of the power plant at the horizon.
layers.paintingTip: Mix Titanium White with a touch of Yellow Ochre and Neutral Tint. Use a size 8 flat brush for clean, geometric edges.

layers.name: Main Chimney
layers.description: The iconic tall chimney stack with its distinctive markings.
layers.paintingTip: Use a rigger brush for the straight vertical lines. Add the red bands at the top with a tiny amount of Cadmium Red once the gray base is dry.

layers.name: Beach and Ground
layers.description: The dark, solid strip of land separating the sky from the water.
layers.paintingTip: Apply a thick, dark wash of Burnt Umber and Indigo. Use dry-brush strokes at the edge to suggest the rough texture of the wet sand.

layers.name: Reflective Water
layers.description: The calm sea surface reflecting the colors of the sunset.
layers.paintingTip: Use horizontal strokes with a large flat brush. Mix Indigo and Payne's Gray, leaving thin white lines to represent the shimmer of light on the water.

elements.content: <linearGradient id="waterGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%"><stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4b5461" /><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a1c21" /></linearGradient>

layers.name: Building Reflections
layers.description: Vertical distortions of the buildings and chimney in the water.
layers.paintingTip: Pull damp vertical strokes downwards from the shoreline using the same colors as the buildings, but diluted. Keep the edges soft and slightly wavy.

layers.name: Industrial Lights
layers.description: Bright points of artificial light and their long vertical reflections.
layers.paintingTip: Use pure Titanium White or Zinc Yellow Gouache for the dots. For the reflections, use a liner brush to create thin, broken vertical lines below each light.

layers.name: Palm Trees and Details
layers.description: Distant palm trees and shoreline structures in silhouette.
layers.paintingTip: Use Lamp Black and a size 0 detail brush. Keep the strokes quick and sharp to suggest the spiky fronds of the palm trees against the sunset glow.
